skills.name: agents-md
skills.description: AGENTS.md: create, shrink, or tend the always-loaded file and agents.d/ after a task when a non-discoverable fact is new, a line is stale or sprawling, or a pointer is missing; also `/agents-md` and `--force`.

skills.name: delegation
skills.description: Turn delegation mode on or off — you orchestrate, subagents execute — for this session, this project, or your user account.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Commit the working tree on the current branch, without pushing.

skills.name: push
skills.description: Follow commit, then push the current branch.

skills.name: release
skills.description: Ship a version — changelog, bump, push, tag, and GitHub release.
